Features

Built around three jobs.

Rynk analyzes what's there, generates every change it would make, and publishes the result. Each capability below is a real piece of the pipeline running today.

01

Pillar 01

Analyze

Crawl, score, and benchmark — rynk understands the site as deeply as a human auditor.

Full-site crawl

Renders every page with a real browser (Crawl4AI), captures titles, metadata, schema, H1s, body, internal links.

Performance scoring

PageSpeed Insights per template — TBT, LCP, CLS, render-blocking resources, image weight.

SERP + AI Overview

SerpAPI on every seed keyword: top-ranking URLs, People-Also-Ask, AI Overview citations, featured snippets.

Keyword + DA metrics

Volume, difficulty, CPC for every keyword. Domain Authority for client and competitors. Swappable provider (mock / Semrush / Ahrefs / DataForSEO).

Onsite & offsite EEAT

Policy pages, author bylines, NAP consistency, certifications, third-party profiles (G2, Crunchbase, Clutch).

Cannibalization detection

URL clusters competing for the same keyword, with a canonical recommendation per cluster.

02

Pillar 02

Generate

Eleven generators produce every change rynk plans — typed, validated, traceable.

CMS work

Meta rewrites, schema injection, 301 redirects, internal links, NAP blocks — all produced as structured actions ready for the CMS adapter.

Full pages

Pillar + spoke pages with titles, meta descriptions, outline, optional LLM-written body (opt-in). Each linked to its schema and image actions.

Images

Hero, inline diagrams, social card thumbnails — prompt + dimensions + alt text, generated at publish time via the configured image provider.

Outreach drafts

Guest pitches, press, backlink requests — full subject and body, staggered send dates, ready for the SEO team to personalize.

Brand posts

LinkedIn thought-leadership, Reddit discussions, Threads short takes — drafted with the brand's voice and a clear rationale per post.

Documents & PRs

Whitepapers + sales decks for distribution. GitHub PR drafts for code-level fixes (when client has a repo).

03

Pillar 03

Publish

Layer 4 dispatches every action to the right service — WordPress, GitHub, image gen, document renderer.

WordPress adapter

Pushes meta, schema, redirects, pages, authors via the WP REST API. Detects which SEO plugin (Yoast / RankMath / SEOPress) is installed.

Image pipeline

Generates each create_image action via DALL-E / Flux / Imagen (or mock). Returns URLs the CMS adapter attaches to the right post.

Document rendering

Markdown → PDF / PPTX via Pandoc. Distributes to SlideShare, Scribd, Issuu.

GitHub PRs

Opens draft pull requests for code-level fixes — proper branch naming, full description, test plan.

Approval gating

Every action carries a risk score and an automatable flag. Humans approve riskier actions before they fire.

Status tracking

Every action records its lifecycle: pending → approved → applied → done. Failed actions retry-able without re-planning.
